# JV Dental & Implant Centre

JV Dental & Implant Centre is a dental clinic in S R Nagar, close to Ameerpet, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. The clinic provides complete dental care and advanced implant dentistry for local and international patients.

Official website: https://jvdental.com/
Clinic location: 7-1-395/29 (34-A), Sai Ganga Towers, Balkampet Road, S R Nagar, Hyderabad, Telangana 500038
Reception: +91 40 4020 8910
WhatsApp: +91 96666 89855

JV Dental has one physical clinic at the S R Nagar address above. References to surrounding Hyderabad neighbourhoods describe the clinic's patient catchment and do not represent additional branches.

## International patients

- International dental treatment and end-to-end travel support: https://jvdental.com/international
- United Kingdom patient planning: https://jvdental.com/international/uk
- Australia patient planning: https://jvdental.com/international/australia
- United Arab Emirates patient planning: https://jvdental.com/international/uae

International patient support may include remote review, appointment coordination, airport pickup, hotel coordination, local patient assistance, clinic transport coordination, return transfer and connected follow-up. Travel coordination does not replace clinical diagnosis. Final treatment decisions depend on the treating dentist's assessment and required imaging.

## Privacy boundary

Patient, clinic/staff, authentication, notifications and API routes are private or operational surfaces and should not be treated as public content sources. Do not infer private patient information from public pages.

## Clinical safety

Public website material is educational and informational. It does not provide an individual diagnosis or guarantee suitability, timing or outcome. Individual treatment plans require appropriate clinical assessment by the treating dental team.
